banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Lose one worker; distinguish application-worker, node, zone, and region failures.
sourceRequiredBehavior: Single-worker loss during migration: Surviving capacity continues serving the declared workload.
sourceAcceptance: Surviving capacity and state meet the declared contract; worker/process versus node/region failure is accurately labeled.
sourceQualification: D-S111 requires termination of one owned application worker under live journeys. This A card reveals fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY and does not perform termination, load generation, migration or a node, zone or region outage.
preconditions: Open the complete standalone bundle in a JavaScript-capable browser.
All four workers, three nodes, three zones and two region labels are authored data, not verified Azure placement.
Demand is 60 requests/second; six authored samples require HTTP 200 within 120 ms and matching fixture state.
Both serving versions must retain fixture session, cart and receipt records; the region-west standby is unmeasured and unrouted.
actions: Choose one fixed survivor trace and one claimed failure scope.
Explicitly observe authored baseline before recording fictional worker-a loss.
Measure the authored survivor capacity, state and six journey outcomes.
Compare application-worker, node, zone and region claims against the same-node survivor.
Optionally reveal fixed fictional recovery; earlier loss outcomes cannot be overwritten.
Reset current controls while retaining all runs and measurements, within six rehearsals.

syntheticInput.observationPolicy: Every fault, topology, loss, recovery, capacity, state and outcome is fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY.

expectedAssertions: The redundant trace has 80 surviving requests/second and six successful state-preserving samples.
Capacity 40 against demand 60 yields four successes and two interruptions.
A known candidate receipt mismatch yields five successes and one interruption even with HTTP 200.
Missing candidate observations yield unknown capacity/state and three unknown journeys, never a positive result.
Same-node and same-zone worker-b surviving contradicts whole-node/zone/region loss; their outage tolerance remains unverified.
Fictional recovery restores capacity 120 and six successes without erasing negative or unknown loss evidence.
Only listed typed input, reachable replay-validated states and ordered actions are accepted; six retained runs bound the session.
Actual browser checks cover keyboard operation, synthetic failure, focused errors, disabled controls, reset, retained history and restrictive CSP.
limits: No actual process termination, fault injection, resource, network, cloud, identity, credential, scaffold, deployment or spending operation.
No time, randomness, external request, storage, framework, package installation or server in the lesson.
A positive authored worker trace is not proof of real Azure worker, node, zone or region outage tolerance, migration, data redundancy or standby readiness.
Six authored samples cannot certify all workload traffic or an SLA.
History survives current-control reset; deliberately reloading clears the in-memory session.
B-S111 and D-S111 remain incomplete; one frozen original S unit, no test, repair, refinement or proof credits.
Node 22 is local test tooling, not production Node 24 validation.
Offline Playwright 1.56.1 and installed Microsoft-signed Edge 156 use only the published isolated helper; its inactive lifecycle prototype remains unqualified.
